name: Circle of Wind
body:
School evocation [air]; Level cleric/oracle 1, druid/shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a crystal ring)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Light winds encircle you, leaving you in the center of a mild vortex. You receive a +2 deflection bonus to AC against ranged attacks. You also receive a +4 bonus on saves against very hot conditions, including the negative impacts of mundane heat (see Environmental Rules for heat effects), and saves against cloud vapors and gases (such as cloudkill, stinking cloud, and inhaled poisons). This spell does not function without air or underwater.
